title: Close-area MPPI: sampling-based MPC (Model Predictive Path Integral) from range returns, alone and on an unknown-map A* path, vs A* on 8 arena families
summary: Own numpy MPPI (information-theoretic update of Williams et al. 2017) for the close-area arena. Every 10 Hz step: integrate the range scan into the arena's log-odds grid (hits only, no prior map), take its ESDF with scipy, sample K = 256 velocity-setpoint sequences over 20 x 0.1 s with AR(1) noise (sigma 0.6 m/s, beta 0.8) plus three fixed samples (nominal, hover, straight at the target), roll them out vectorised on the arena point-mass model (tau 0.15 s lag, 3 m/s^2, 2 m/s, 50 Hz substeps, checked against vehicle.py), cost = distance to the target over the horizon + terminal distance + ESDF obstacle cost + collision penalty + setpoint smoothness + the information-theoretic cross term, softmin weights with temperature lambda = 1, send the first setpoint and warm-start the next step. Two variants: make(guide='none') targets B directly; make(guide='astar') targets a point 2 m along the arena's unknown-map A* path on the same map, with a pull towards the path, replacing the A* carrot follower. bench.py flies both and the benchmark's geofenced unknown-map A* on random, u_trap, narrow_gap, office, warehouse, forest, maze and glass_office (20 layouts, seed 0, ideal 72-ray sensor) and on random and office with the Crazyflie 4-beam preset, with the close-area-benchmark flight loop (astar_unknown rows identical to its matrix run by run); sweep.py sweeps K 64/256/1024 x horizon 1/2/4 s on random and maze; one-process step timing. numpy + scipy only, so it fits the Pyodide browser playground. Synthetic arena only.
verified: ran 2026-11-10 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.6.2, 16 CPUs), in the sample venv: bench.py --preset ideal --layouts 20 --seed 0 --workers 14 (wall 99.1 s) and --preset crazyflie --families random,office (wall 15.2 s) wrote results/bench_*_0.json/.md; their astar_unknown runs are identical to close-area-benchmark/results/matrix_0.json in outcome, min clearance and path length (160/160 ideal, 40/40 crazyflie). A second ideal run gave identical outcome, min clearance, path length and time to goal in 480/480 runs (results/determinism_check.txt). bench.py --timing --workers 1 (wall 65.8 s) wrote results/timing_0.*; sweep.py --layouts 10 --seed 0 --workers 14 (flights wall 91.6 s) wrote results/sweep_0.*; the dev-seed run bench.py --seed 1 --layouts 10 wrote results/bench_ideal_1.*. A first seed-0 sweep before the straight-at-target sample was added is kept as results/sweep_0_before_direct_sample.* (superseded). Every number in README is from results/ or labelled console-only. test_smoke.py: 1 passed in the venv (rollout vs arena vehicle within 1e-9 m, make() with no arguments steps, u_trap run 0 matches results), 1 skipped under plain python3 without numpy. Browser loading was emulated in CPython by copying the manifest's arena files and this sample's arena.py + mppi.py into a Pyodide-like folder layout and loading them with the playground's _load_sample recipe (3 runs on office layout 0); it was not run in Pyodide and Pyodide timing is not measured. Layouts, vehicle and sensor are simulated, pose is truth; no SITL, no real drone, no estimator faults.
shows: MPPI with and without an A* guide against the unknown-map A* on 8 room families and 2 sensors: whether sampling-based MPC escapes U traps and mazes, reach, collisions, time to B, clearance, step time, K x horizon sweep
runtime: ~100 s main bench on 14 processes, ~16 s crazyflie, ~66 s one-process timing, ~95 s sweep
key_result: [20 layouts per family, seed 0, ideal sensor](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-10-apple-m3-max-cpython-31210-numpy-254-scipy-1181): MPPI alone 0 % reached on u_trap and maze (stuck, like VFH+ and DWA); MPPI on an A* lookahead point reached 95-100 % in 7 families where A* reached 90-100 %, warehouse 65 vs 55 %, 0 % collisions for both, faster median time to B in 7 of 8 families (maze 33.62 vs 50.06 s); Crazyflie 4-beam preset: 20 % (random) and 85 % (office) collisions against A*'s 0 % and 25 %; step 4.2-4.3 ms median, 87 ms max with A* replans in one process

readiness.limitation: Synthetic 2.5D point-mass arena with true pose on one M3 Max; collides often with a 4-beam sensor; not run in Pyodide; setup needs PyPI wheels and its cold time was not measured.
